title: REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject control for executions awaiting approval
summary: ExecutionPanel renders Reject next to Approve and calls onReject with the execution id
description: ExecutionPanel gains an optional onReject prop and renders a Reject button only when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject is provided.
acceptance_criteria: Given status AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject, when Reject is clicked, then onReject is called with the execution id
Given status FAILED or no onReject, when rendered, then no Reject button is present
definition_of_done: Reject button gated by status and handler
